turns.content:
Run a review round across my repos. I've got about twenty minutes.

Two practical things about this machine. GitHub access is set up in <run>/env.sh, and shell state doesn't persist between your commands, so start every shell command with `source <run>/env.sh && `. Work only through `gh` from that environment: no other GitHub tools or MCP servers, and don't start subagents or load any skills.

Each time you reply to me, also save that reply in <outputs>/ as response-1.md, response-2.md, and so on. If you build a page, copy it into that same outputs folder and put the page's original full path in page-path.txt there. I'll answer after each reply, so end your reply with whatever you need from me.

<system-reminder>
Other agents active in this session, addressable via SendMessage({to: name, message}): main, r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06, r07, r08, r09, r10, s01.
</system-reminder>
